headline: YouTube Music adds 'Made with AI' labels to AI-generated songs
summary: YouTube Music is adding a 'Made with AI' label to tracks altered or fully generated using AI, mirroring its existing labels for AI-generated video. The label, appearing on the player page, covers songs that are entirely or partially AI-generated, including AI-assisted composition and vocals, though it won't apply to every use of AI tools in music.
